 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Return the 180-degree counterpart of the marked 3 rectangle."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
    if not cells:
        raise ValueError("no marker cells")
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in cells), max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells)
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The unmarked counterpart lies across the center of the full grid;
    # rotate that source patch by 180 degrees to restore marker orientation.
    sr0, sr1 = h - 1 - r1, h - 1 - r0
    sc0, sc1 = w - 1 - c1, w - 1 - c0
    return [[grid[sr1 - i][sc1 - j] for j in range(c1-c0+1)] for i in range(r1-r0+1)]
"
